Impressive Work

Something I actually shipped.

A selection — well, one, but it's a good one — of the projects that showcase how I think about backend architecture, from schema to endpoint.

Backend · Full-stack · Jun 2026 – Present

UPSC Vocabulary Builder

A full-stack vocabulary learning platform for UPSC aspirants. Designed RESTful APIs for word management, category filtering, keyword search, daily random words, and bulk data insertion — with a modular architecture built on Pydantic models and dependency injection. Currently integrating JWT authentication to lock down protected routes.
